title: Deloitte to cut key benefits for support staff in 2027
description: Deloitte will reduce parental leave, paid time off, fertility support, and pension accruals for U.S. employees in internal support roles starting January 2027. The changes target staff in the firm's new 'Center' talent model, part of a broader restructuring amid rising costs, AI disruption, ...

title: Deloitte to scale back parental leave, PTO for select US employees under new talent model - Storyboard18
description: Deloitte is reducing parental leave, paid time off and fertility-related benefits for employees in its “Center” segment as part of a restructuring of its workforce classification system, with changes set to take effect from January 2027.
